_comment: L1.c of docs/2026-09-07_latent_intent_design.zh.md (pre-registered 2026-09-08, user decision: priority raised to right after L1.b hr16). The training-time LPV corridor + glidepath penalty (objective.procedure_loss, hinge^2 on the metres outside k*hw(d) / the glidepath window on truth-established rows, control path = through the rollout dynamics) was vetoed on 2026-09-05 on simple-v3 WITH the imitation teacher at 64 (87 % of the loss): FDE better, vectored ADE +658 m, bank collapse at 5e-3. L1.b removes the teacher, so whether the term integrates without the mid-path cost is unmeasured -- that is the new evidence. BASE = the L1.b decision rule's main-line supervision: hr8+TV (the 180-epoch survivor) as committed here; if an hr16 arm passes the L1.b gate the base is edited to that arm BEFORE this campaign is launched (one line, recorded in the doc). Doses: 2e-4 is the control-path PARITY dose (1e-3 was 4.4x the position term at epoch 1 on control vs 0.78x on state; 1e-3/4.4 = 2.3e-4), 1e-3 is the dose whose 09-05 result is on file. Two predict-only arms put the soft barrier hook (the deployable inference-time alternative, net gain on 09-06) on the base and on the parity arm, so the reading is 'training-time term vs inference hook vs both' on ONE base. Gates in the doc: violation rate down >= 5 points AND vectored ADE not worse than base by > 30 m AND bank skill >= 0.70; veto: vectored ADE > +100 m or straight-in FDE worse than seed noise. Dual step stays 0 (diverged on state, not re-tested). Order matters: the predict-only arms read checkpoints the earlier arms write.

L1.b base + the penalty at the 2026-09-05 dose (lambda 1e-3), for continuity

parity-dose penalty arm + soft barrier hook at prediction time (do they combine?)
